t: You're in Holland Park, a park in Kensington. Part of its story belongs to Giles Fox-Strangways, the sixth Earl of Ilchester, who lived from 1874 to 1959 and once owned it. He was a British peer and philanthropist, and until 1905 he was known by the courtesy title Lord Stavordale. The material I have doesn't say more about his time here, so I'll leave it at that.
